what: A line of uppercase text wrapped around a large circle (repeated and joined with ✿ so it fills the circumference, stretched to fit exactly) rotates tied to scroll — it turns by the progress through the section × 360° with no curve, and reverses on scrolling back. A sentence ring wraps a circle that straddles a section boundary, such as where the lime panel ends in a big circle or around the award disc.

options.text: Text to wrap, default is aria-label
options.trigger: Ancestor selector (closest) used to measure progress, defaults to the element itself
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start · end, default top bottom · bottom top — the original lime panel uses top+=1 top · bottom, the award disc is top-=5% bottom · bottom+=35% top
options.turns: Number of wheel turns while passing through the section, default 1
options.scale: Pair size while spinning, default 1 — award disc is 1.05
options.size: Font size (based on circle diameter 1000), default 14
options.inset: From the circle edge to the top of the text (based on diameter 1000), default 4
options.side: If ”bottom”, the text winds counterclockwise so it reads upright at the bottom of the circle (letter tops face the center and stand on the inside of the rim) — for spots where only the lower half of the circle shows. By default it reads upright at the top
options.repeat · sep: Number of sets and joiner marks per lap, default measures one set’s length so the circumference fills exactly · ” ✿ ”
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: When rotating a hand-drawn ring (art or SVG) — if present, it rotates this instead of generating text
options.lag: Lag behind scroll in seconds, default 0 (sticks immediately) — the Brand contact button (Webflow smoothing 80) uses .8

from.where: index.html .h-arc circle around the bottom of the lime panel (original curvedText rotate 360×progress, top+=1 top → bottom) · .h-win award disc (rotate 360×progress · scale 1.05, top−5vh bottom → bottom+35% top)
shared.js .oc-contact (pink contact button at bottom right, text ring — whole-page progress 0→360°, trigger body · top top · bottom bottom)
